svg.aria-label: Provenance architecture: the action pipeline and the memory write path, both gated by deterministic code
svg.text: Provenance — an LLM never decides what the organization does,
and never decides what the organization believes.
Every green box is deterministic code. Nothing crosses from a blue box to a state change or a committed belief except through one.
emits one TYPED action: class, target,
identity → RBAC / ABAC → DETERMINISTIC risk table
read at request time, never cached
the rest is new code here
Full design: ARCHITECTURE.md §1.1 states each of the four load-bearing properties with what it rules out.
